content: For individuals who successfully achieve weight loss, it is crucial to provide long-term support to sustain their progress. Regular follow-up appointments are necessary to monitor body weight consistently over time. Patients are encouraged to engage in self-monitoring strategies, such as periodic weigh-ins and tracking their physical activity levels, as these practices can help them stay accountable and detect early signs of weight regain. Continuous support in these areas is vital to prevent the recurrence of weight gain and to preserve the positive outcomes attained during the initial weight loss phase. Furthermore, maintaining a physical activity regimen of approximately 200 to 300 minutes per week is strongly recommended to promote long-term weight stability and overall health.
